decisions.reason: A mitred lever handle family builds directly on the firm's core metal-forming and finishing expertise and fits its coordinated product families, so it remains easy to assimilate and refine even with modest visibility.

Its move to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing commitment, and its multifunctionality ties into the firm's barrier-free and system-solution know-how, where the firm can interpret results and improve the product.
This single lever handle sits squarely within the firm's existing knowledge base, but its unchanged low website profile suggests limited learning signals, so it carries some risk of rationalisation.

The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and has a page of its own, giving strong, interpretable evidence of value that the firm can build on with its design and engineering capabilities.
